sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Color Brick are simple yet engaging. The game is played on a grid, where you have to tap on the screen to move a brick to a specific position. The goal is to match the color of the brick with the color of the target brick. If you succeed in matching the colors, the brick will break, and you'll earn points. The game gets increasingly difficult as you progress through the levels, with more bricks on the grid and more complex color combinations.

The game also has a variety of brick types, each with its own unique characteristics. Some bricks may have multiple colors, while others may have special powers that can help or hinder your progress. You'll need to use your wits to figure out which bricks to use and when.

One of the key features of Color Brick is its intuitive controls. You can play the game using your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, making it accessible to players of all skill levels. The game also has a gentle learning curve, so you can start playing right away without feeling overwhelmed.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Color Brick are engaging, challenging, and easy to learn. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a casual player, you'll find Color Brick to be a fun and addictive game that will keep you entertained for hours.
